file: POV - HE CAME FROM ANGOLA TO CELEBRATE PRIDE IN ISRAEL - V1.mp4
title:
POV: HE CAME FROM ANGOLA
TO CELEBRATE PRIDE IN ISRAEL 🇮🇱
people: Man from Angola visiting Tel Aviv for Pride (gay; black gay man, his words)
hook: Wait, you came to Israel to celebrate gay pride? — Of course, honey.
note: Pride/LGBT — new topic for the page, Tal to decide. No Pride-crowd b-roll used (its audio is a commercial song). Cut: 'I'm scared with the things that happened in the last years', the Angola-has-no-protection/homophobia stretch, the garbled subway story, and the garbled 'so I was only one in two'. His English is non-native and captioned as spoken ('celebrate a pride', 'where was the drag show'), except ASR 'I'm feel safe' captioned as 'I feel safe'.
